title: CNBC Daily Open: Trump is doubling down on rhetoric to end the Iran war
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump's escalating rhetoric and threats against Iran amidst the ongoing conflict have led to a surge in oil prices and a drop in U.S. markets. Concurrently, quantum technology firms are advancing towards commercialization by going public, despite market volatility.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a strongly negative market impact due to geopolitical tensions causing oil price spikes and market downturns, overshadowing the positive developments in the quantum technology sector.
